Kit summary

Undead CodexActive
Deals 450% ATK Poison DMG to a single enemy, then refreshes the duration of all Poison effects on the target.
Undead ImpactActive
Deals 2 stages of 500% ATK Poison DMG each to all enemies. The second stage also reduces Turn Meter by 20%.
Nether Grimoire Lv.1When all other allies have cast an active skill at least once, Hades immediately casts it once (and resets the count). After casting it, gains 1 layer of Soul Protection.
Undead RitualPassive
Immune to Turn Meter reduction. Enemy afflicted with control: +20% ATK (max 5 layers). Enemy immune to control: +50% Turn Meter (once before her action each turn). Each Poison inflicted on an enemy grants 1 layer of Soul Protection (+10% Skill DMG and Mastery, max 10). At the start of her turn, removes all Poison from enemies and inflicts Undead Poison equal to her Soul Protection layers (before acting takes 100% of Hades' ATK as Poison DMG, max 10 layers, ignores DMG Immunity, benefits from Skill DMG bonuses, reduces the unit's DMG dealt by 30%).
Nether Grimoire Lv.2At battle start, every 1% Mastery gives +0.5% Effect Hit (max +120%). Gains 10% Direct DMG Reduction and DoT Reduction per enemy with Soul Shackle. Undead Poison DMG restores her HP equal to the DMG dealt. At the start of each enemy's turn, 100% chance to inflict ATK Down II for 1 turn (plus Cold II if the target has Soul Shackle).
Nether Grimoire Lv.3When an enemy with Soul Shackle revives, inflicts 1 layer of Eternal Curse (-20% Max HP, not removed on death, max 3 layers).
Undead ChantActive
Grants ATK Up II to all allies for 2 turns and 100% chance to raise all enemy active skill CDs by 1 turn (max 5). Then deals 3 stages of 300% ATK Poison DMG to all enemies, each with a 30% chance to inflict 1 layer of Soul Shackle (-20% Mastery RES and Crit DMG, max 3). At 3 layers for the first time, inflicts Nether Curse (-30% SPD; Poison DMG taken reduces Turn Meter by 20%, once before the owner's action each turn).
Nether Grimoire Lv.3Casts it once at battle start, removing Block Debuff from all enemies. When any enemy first reaches 2 layers of Soul Shackle, 100% chance to Stun it for 1 turn. Each time Hades cumulatively takes DMG over 30% of Max HP, cleanses all control and casts it once (once before her action).
Nether Grimoire (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.

The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

If the owner is from Eternal Sect:
